newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from NOS Recordings' official demo, home and release pages. The label accepts house music only, limits each submission to three tracks, prohibits attachments, requests private SoundCloud links with downloads enabled or Box/Dropbox, asks for a brief artist and label-fit introduction and accepts finished polished work even when unmastered. A separate opt-in can make a demo eligible for livestream A&R feedback on YouTube or Twitch. No mandatory fee, login or visible CAPTCHA was observed in the publicly rendered route, but the complete live form controls, consent text and submit-time anti-abuse checks were not exercised. The official site currently lists NOS 053 — Whatchu Need as its newest release, NOS in Miami 2026 as NOS 052 and a live Summer 2026 collection. Exact public support addresses on the terms page were obfuscated by the renderer and were not recovered or inferred. No form field, link, upload, email, opt-in, payment or submission was used.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from the official RekHeard Breakerz website and embedded artist workflow. The platform accepts one clean, club-ready, radio-friendly English-language Soca, Reggae or Dancehall single; riddim tracks are excluded and the song must already be on Spotify. The form requests artist and location details, Instagram, optional TikTok, a clean Spotify URL, a tagged non-expiring MP3 download link, a non-expiring high-resolution artist-photo link and a meaningful song story. Google Drive links must grant access to info@rekheardbreakerz.com. Mandatory consent grants permission to review, discuss, play excerpts, feature, publish, share and promote the track and submitted identity/media across podcast, video, website, playlists, social media, email and promotional platforms when selected. A separate mandatory checkbox also subscribes the artist to submission and platform email updates, with unsubscribe stated. The site reports more than 440 submissions, more than 25 countries, more than 12,000 YouTube subscribers and four currently streaming Season 1 episodes. No fee, login or visible CAPTCHA was observed, but hidden Wix controls and the final submit boundary were not exercised. No form field, Drive permission, link, consent, email or submission was used.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from COOL Recordings' official public A&R form and its current Beatport catalogue. The Austrian label accepts House, Tech House and Afro House through private SoundCloud or Dropbox links only, rejects unfinished tracks and short snippets, requires downloads enabled and says it contacts fitting artists within two weeks. Visible fields request artist name, direct email, track link, social portfolio and an A&R note. No mandatory fee, login or visible CAPTCHA was observed; hidden anti-spam, consent and submit-time controls remain unknown because the form was not used. Current marketplace activity is confirmed by El Patronato, released on COOL Recordings on 5 June 2026, Banger Recipe and Disco Nect on 15 May 2026 and Midnight on 25 April 2026. No exact first-party business mailbox is published on the single-page official form, so the form remains the only stored route. No field, private link, email, payment or submission was used.
